description: Extreme flood return levels in a U.S. mid-Atlantic estuary using 40-year fluvial-coastal model simulations is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Mithun Deb et al. Using an integrated watershed-coastal modeling framework, we conducted long-term historical simulations (1980-2019) of fluvial and coastal flooding in the Delaware Bay and River, a vulnerable estuarine system in the U.S., at high spatial resolutions. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: Excel, MATLAB, Image. The data are held in MultiSector Dynamics - Living, Intuitive, Value-adding, Environment and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
